objective: qualify one prompt-free flower-candidate ROI estimator without weakening the immutable v2 STOP

immutable_v2_stop.rule: do not rerun, round, retune or reinterpret CLIPSeg v2

outcome_firewall.source_only_inspection_already_performed: archive hashes, official split metadata, exact duplicate hashes, and the RGB encoding summary of Oxford-102 development proxy image 6765; no estimator output was computed

estimator.license: NVIDIA Source Code License for SegFormer; non-commercial research and evaluation only

preprocessing_and_roi.orientation: apply EXIF orientation then convert once to RGB
preprocessing_and_roi.analysis_canvas: pinned processor resize to 512 by 512 using bilinear resampling; colour and annotations are evaluated on that same canvas
preprocessing_and_roi.logit_rule: bilinearly upsample the 150-channel logits to 512 by 512 with align_corners=false, then hard argmax
preprocessing_and_roi.flower_roi: every hard class-66 pixel; retain every component

jrc_field_gate.source: European Commission JRC Flower Detection dataset from the 2018 LUCAS grassland module
jrc_field_gate.development_rule: run all 400 official train images; if the frozen test criteria are not met on train, stop before test
jrc_field_gate.locked_rule: after a development pass is committed, run all 100 official test images exactly once
jrc_field_gate.box_hit_rule: after scaling a reference box to the 512 canvas, require at least max(9, ceiling(0.05 times box area)) class-66 pixels inside the box
jrc_field_gate.failure_rule: save every row and STOP before atlas image acquisition; never change the test denominator or thresholds

oxford102_proxy.role: automatic-segmentation algorithm-agreement sensitivity; never human ground truth and never sufficient alone
oxford102_proxy.development: official train plus validation after exact-duplicate exclusion
oxford102_proxy.locked_selection: 20 per class from official test by ascending SHA-256 of salt, class, image SHA-256 and image ID after exclusions
oxford102_proxy.source_mask_limit: official masks were generated by an automatic iterative MRF and shape procedure and may be empty or erroneous
oxford102_proxy.failure_rule: record not_supported algorithm agreement; do not alter the independent JRC decision

pixel_gate.decision: the paired JRC manual-box field gate and balanced Oxford-102 automatic-mask sensitivity are sufficient only for automated flower-candidate colour claims, not pixel-perfect petal claims
pixel_gate.future_source: FlowerMaskDataset v1 DOI 10.17632/3pw57gdcj2.1 may supersede this ceiling only after a complete archive is independently acquired and frozen before scoring

ordered_execution: freeze and validate source inventories without decoding locked images
run JRC train development and stop before test unless its locked thresholds pass
commit the development result and executable identity
run all 100 JRC test images once
run the balanced Oxford-102 proxy sensitivity once
open scaleout images only if the JRC field gate passes and every other inference-v3 dependency passes
claim_ceiling: automated flower-candidate localization suitable for non-commercial research under the pinned model, with field box localization and automatic-mask agreement quantified; not pixel-perfect petals, taxon-uniform error, calibrated camera colour, pollinator vision, causation or commercial-use permission
